candidates.original_title: Methylation at SLC6A4 is linked to family history of child abuse: an examination of the Iowa Adoptee sample
candidates.description: Childhood sex abuse is associated with methylation at the 5HTT promoter region, and methylation mediates the impact of child sex abuse on symptoms of antisocial personality disorder in women
candidates.citation_sentence: Replicating prior research (8), we found that the degree of methylation of the CpG island upstream from SLC6A4 was associated with reported sex abuse during childhood among women.
candidates.notes: The paper replicates Beach et al. (2010) using a new nonoverlapping sample of 155 women from the Iowa Adoptee Study. All hypothesized main effects were significant and in the predicted direction; mediation was supported. No DOI is provided for the original study in the text, so original_url is left blank.

candidates.original_title: Methylation at SLC6A4 is linked to family history of child abuse: an examination of the Iowa Aadoptee sample
candidates.description: Child sex abuse is associated with overall hypermethylation of the 5HTT promoter region among women.
candidates.citation_sentence: In earlier work, we found that child abuse, including physical abuse, harsh parenting, and sex abuse, was associated with overall hypermethylation of the 5HTT promoter region [8].
candidates.notes: The paper cites the original numerically as reference [8] rather than using an author-year citation. The mediation of ASPD symptoms and genotype-methylation interaction are extensions, not separate replications of the prior study's effect.
